name: terminal_exec
title: Sandboxed Coding Terminal
description: General CLI fallback inside the authorized execution scope. Prefer an active dedicated MCP tool whenever it fully covers the operation, including structured Git, filesystem, code, and network tools. Use terminal for builds, tests, package managers, interpreters, scripts, process/user-service commands, shell pipelines, and unsupported operations. Uses direct argv; shell syntax requires an explicit shell. Credentials, privilege brokers, and generic SSH remain unavailable. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit status.

execution_mode.description: Use sync for short commands whose result is needed immediately, async for long-running work that should survive the initial request, or auto to use task execution when the client supports Tasks and the call is safe to resume.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for one logical async command. Required for async terminal execution so retries or lost responses resolve to the same accepted task instead of running the command twice.

timeout_ms.description: Requested command runtime in milliseconds. Choose a realistic value for the operation; 0 means no command deadline unless the relay operator configured a maximum.

name: ssh_readonly_exec
title: Read-Only SSH Diagnostics
description: Run one server-validated read-only diagnostic command on an operator-configured SSH alias. Alias/config/key resolution is relay-owned; raw SSH options, interactive access, forwarding, and remote mutation are unavailable.

alias.description: Operator-configured SSH alias resolved by the relay.

command.description: One reviewed remote diagnostic executable/family such as docker, git, curl, or uptime.

execution_mode.description: Use sync for immediate results, async for task-backed execution, or auto to use MCP Tasks when negotiated.

timeout_ms.description: Requested remote diagnostic runtime in milliseconds; 0 uses the bounded relay SSH default.

name: http_fetch
title: HTTP Fetch
description: Make an HTTP(S) request and return the response; methods may mutate remote state.

execution_mode.description: Use sync for short requests, async for eligible long-running safe requests, or auto to use task execution when supported. Mutating HTTP methods remain synchronous until request-level idempotency is available.

idempotency_key.description: Stable logical-operation key reserved for task-backed requests that require retry deduplication.

timeout_ms.description: Requested HTTP operation timeout in milliseconds. Choose it based on expected latency; the relay still enforces this tool's maximum.

name: web_search
title: Web Search
description: Search the web through the configured SearxNG backend and return matching results.

execution_mode.description: Use sync for an immediate result, async when the search may take longer and the client can poll MCP Tasks, or auto to let the relay select task execution when supported.

name: directory_list
title: Directory List
description: List a workspace directory with deterministic ordering, bounded recursion, entry types, and explicit truncation without following symlink directories.

name: file_search
title: File Search
description: Search regular workspace files using a bounded glob subset (*, ?, and ** path segments) with deterministic cwd-relative results. Hidden files are searchable; .git, node_modules, target, .nuxt, and .output directories are skipped; symlinks observed during traversal are not followed recursively. On Linux, descendant traversal uses stable directory descriptors with no-follow opens. Native entries whose names are not valid UTF-8 are omitted from JSON results.

name: file_write
title: File Write
description: Atomically create or explicitly overwrite a contained UTF-8 text file. overwrite=false and create_parents=false are the defaults. Parent traversal uses no-follow directory descriptors; symlinked parents/final targets and root escapes are rejected. New files use mode 0644; overwrites preserve existing permissions.

name: file_edit
title: File Edit
description: Apply one or more exact anchored UTF-8 text replacements inside an existing contained regular file, then commit the complete result atomically. The legacy old_text/new_text form edits a single occurrence; edits[] batches independent anchors against the original file. By default each anchor must match exactly once; replace_all=true is explicit. Final symlinks, ambiguous/overlapping matches, stale entry identity, oversized content, and root escapes fail before commit.

name: file_read
title: File Read
description: Read a contained UTF-8 text file using 1-based line ranges with hard line/byte bounds and explicit truncation. Directories, invalid UTF-8, external symlink targets, oversized lines, and out-of-root paths are rejected.

name: text_search
title: Text Search
description: Search workspace text with ripgrep using direct argv in a read-only execution-root sandbox. Defaults to literal, case-sensitive matching; regex=true enables regex syntax. Ripgrep's normal hidden/ignore behavior applies, symlinks are not followed, previews and total results are server-bounded.

name: git_status
title: Git Status
description: Inspect bounded structured repository status without invoking user Git helpers.

name: git_diff
title: Git Diff
description: Read a bounded Git diff with external diff and textconv disabled; continuation is signed and bound to the repository and diff query.

name: git_log
title: Git Log
description: Read bounded commit metadata from repository history.

name: git_show
title: Git Show
description: Read bounded commit/object presentation with executable diff helpers disabled; continuation is signed and bound to the resolved object.

name: git_blame
title: Git Blame
description: Read bounded line-to-commit mappings for one contained repository file.

name: git_branch_list
title: Git Branch List
description: List bounded local branch identities and current/upstream facts without invoking user Git helpers.

name: git_branch_create
title: Git Branch Create
description: Create one validated local branch at HEAD or an explicit contained commit start point without switching the worktree.

name: git_branch_switch
title: Git Branch Switch
description: Switch to one existing validated local branch without force, detach, remote guessing, or carrying a dirty worktree.

name: git_stage
title: Git Stage
description: Stage an explicit bounded set of contained repository file paths; protected paths and unsafe symlinks are denied.

name: git_unstage
title: Git Unstage
description: Unstage an explicit bounded set of contained repository file paths without changing worktree content.

name: git_commit
title: Git Commit
description: Create one local commit from the already-staged index using bounded message input and repository-local identity only; user hooks and global Git config remain disabled.

name: git_commit_amend
title: Git Commit Amend
description: Amend HEAD with staged changes and/or a bounded replacement message; user hooks, signing, editors, and global Git config remain disabled.

name: git_operation_status
title: Git Operation Status
description: Inspect bounded structured merge/rebase state and conflicted paths for the contained repository.

name: git_merge_start
title: Git Merge Start
description: Start a bounded local no-ff merge from a validated commit ref; conflicts are returned through structured operation state.

name: git_merge_continue
title: Git Merge Continue
description: Continue an active merge only after all conflicts are resolved and staged.

name: git_merge_abort
title: Git Merge Abort
description: Abort the active contained-repository merge operation.

name: git_rebase_start
title: Git Rebase Start
description: Start a bounded local rebase onto a validated commit ref; conflicts are returned through structured operation state.

name: git_rebase_continue
title: Git Rebase Continue
description: Continue an active rebase only after all conflicts are resolved and staged.

name: git_rebase_abort
title: Git Rebase Abort
description: Abort the active contained-repository rebase operation.

name: git_branch_delete
title: Git Branch Delete
description: Delete one non-current local branch using Git's merged-state safety check; force deletion is unavailable.

name: git_remote_list
title: Git Remote List
description: Inspect validated repository remotes and canonical GitHub repository identity without exposing credentials or user Git config.

name: git_remote_branch_get
title: Git Remote Branch Get
description: Read one validated remote branch head through the narrow authenticated Git transport and return bounded identity facts.

name: git_fetch
title: Git Fetch
description: Fetch one validated GitHub branch into its bounded remote-tracking ref using the credential-isolated native transport.

name: git_push
title: Git Push
description: Push one validated local branch to the same-name branch of the validated GitHub remote without force, hooks, arbitrary refspecs, or credential exposure; verify the resulting remote head.

name: workspace_add
title: Workspace Add
description: Explicitly authorize an additional existing directory as a workspace root for the current session. Rejects root/system directories and credential paths.

name: workspace_list
title: Workspace List
description: List all currently authorized workspace roots, including primary and dynamically authorized roots.

name: workspace_get
title: Workspace Get
description: Inspect an authorized workspace root by path.

name: workspace_remove
title: Workspace Remove
description: Remove a dynamically authorized workspace root from the allowlist. Primary workspace root cannot be removed.

name: git_worktree_list
title: Git Worktree List
description: List bounded worktrees for the current Git repository with containment and branch status.

name: git_worktree_get
title: Git Worktree Get
description: Inspect a specific Git worktree by path.

name: git_worktree_add
title: Git Worktree Add
description: Create and register a new Git worktree at a validated destination within an authorized workspace root.

name: git_worktree_remove
title: Git Worktree Remove
description: Remove a linked Git worktree.

name: git_worktree_prune
title: Git Worktree Prune
description: Prune stale worktree metadata.

name: git_stash_list
title: Git Stash List
description: List bounded stashes in the repository.

name: git_stash_push
title: Git Stash Push
description: Stash modified and untracked changes with optional message and path filters.

name: git_stash_pop
title: Git Stash Pop
description: Apply and drop a stash by index.

name: git_stash_apply
title: Git Stash Apply
description: Apply a stash by index without dropping it.

name: git_stash_drop
title: Git Stash Drop
description: Drop a stash by index.

name: git_tag_list
title: Git Tag List
description: List bounded repository tags with commit SHA and subject.

name: git_tag_create
title: Git Tag Create
description: Create a lightweight or annotated Git tag at a target ref.

name: git_tag_delete
title: Git Tag Delete
description: Delete a Git tag by name.

name: git_branch_rename
title: Git Branch Rename
description: Rename a local Git branch.

name: git_restore
title: Git Restore
description: Restore working tree or staged files from HEAD or a specified source ref.

name: git_clean
title: Git Clean
description: Remove untracked files from the working tree with dry_run safety by default.

name: git_cherry_pick
title: Git Cherry Pick
description: Apply changes from an existing commit onto the current branch.

name: git_revert
title: Git Revert
description: Revert an existing commit by creating a new inverse commit.

name: git_reset
title: Git Reset
description: Reset HEAD or unstage files using soft or mixed mode. Hard reset is blocked.

name: git_remote_add
title: Git Remote Add
description: Add a named remote to the Git repository with URL validation.

name: git_remote_remove
title: Git Remote Remove
description: Remove a named remote from the repository.

name: git_remote_set_url
title: Git Remote Set URL
description: Update the URL of an existing Git remote.

name: git_remote_branch_delete
title: Git Remote Branch Delete
description: Delete one non-default validated GitHub remote branch only when its current head matches expected_sha; verify absence after mutation.

name: change_request_list
title: Change Request List
description: List bounded change-request summaries for the validated forge repository using a provider-neutral result contract.

name: change_request_get
title: Change Request Get
description: Read one bounded change-request summary including base/head identity, mergeability, and review-decision classification.

name: change_request_create
title: Change Request Create
description: Create a change request for an already-pushed validated head branch without implicit push/fork behavior or arbitrary provider API access.

name: change_request_update
title: Change Request Update
description: Update only bounded title/body/base fields on one validated change request; reviewer/admin/provider passthrough flags are unavailable.

name: change_request_checks
title: Change Request Checks
description: Read bounded check classifications for one validated change request without returning raw provider logs.

name: change_request_merge
title: Change Request Merge
description: Merge one eligible change request using an explicit strategy only when the observed head SHA still matches and current checks/review state permit it; admin/auto/bypass flags are unavailable.

name: apply_patch
title: Apply Patch
description: Apply a constrained unified text patch to existing contained regular files. All targets and hunks are preflighted; symlinks, protected paths, stale context, adds/deletes/renames, binary content, and root escapes fail closed. dry_run validates without mutation; commit uses atomic per-file replacement with best-effort rollback if a later file fails.

name: code_symbols
title: Code Symbols
description: Bounded document symbols for one contained source file, or workspace symbol search when a query is given (only if the language server advertises workspace-symbol support). Language is inferred from the file extension / project markers; never both path and query ambiguity.

name: code_definition
title: Code Definition
description: Bounded, contained definition locations for a symbol at a UTF-8 file position, using real language-server semantics.

name: code_references
title: Code References
description: Bounded, contained reference locations for a symbol at a UTF-8 file position.

name: code_implementations
title: Code Implementations
description: Bounded, contained implementation locations for a symbol at a UTF-8 file position. Capability-gated: returns a distinct unsupported-capability error when the language server does not advertise implementation search.

name: code_hover
title: Code Hover
description: Bounded plain/markdown hover (type/docs) text for a symbol at a UTF-8 file position. Server-provided markdown is treated as inert text, never rendered as executable HTML.

name: code_diagnostics
title: Code Diagnostics
description: Bounded normalized diagnostics for one contained source file, including severity, stable diagnostic code when available, source, and document version (when the server reports one), so a stale result can be detected.

name: code_rename_preview
title: Code Rename Preview
description: Preview-only bounded rename: normalizes the language server's WorkspaceEdit into per-file text replacements without applying anything. Apply the result yourself through apply_patch/file_edit after review. Rejects edits outside the contained workspace, protected paths, unsafe symlinks, and any unsupported resource operation (file create/rename/delete).

name: telegram_send_message
title: Telegram Send Message
description: Send one bounded plain-text message to the relay's fixed operator-configured Telegram destination. Every call must include the absolute working directory associated with the message; the relay validates it against the currently authorized workspace roots and prepends the canonical directory server-side. Telegram credentials, destination, topic, and endpoint remain relay-owned and cannot be supplied by callers.

name: terminal_job_start
title: Start Terminal Job
description: Start a bounded sandboxed general CLI fallback job for builds, tests, package managers, interpreters, scripts, or unsupported operations. Prefer an active dedicated MCP tool when it fully covers the operation. Returns a task ID for polling; the same credential, privilege, and SSH boundaries as terminal_exec apply.

name: terminal_job_get
title: Get Terminal Job
description: Get bounded state and retained output for a terminal job.

name: terminal_job_cancel
title: Cancel Terminal Job
description: Cancel a running terminal job and its process group.

name: issue_list
title: Issue List
description: List bounded issue summaries for the validated forge repository using a provider-neutral result contract.

name: issue_get
title: Issue Get
description: Read one bounded issue summary and body for the validated forge repository.

name: issue_create
title: Issue Create
description: Create a new issue in the validated forge repository without arbitrary provider API access.

name: issue_update
title: Issue Update
description: Update bounded title, body, and labels on one validated issue; arbitrary provider flags are unavailable.

name: issue_comment
title: Issue Comment
description: Add a bounded comment to one validated issue without returning or querying full comment threads.

name: issue_close
title: Issue Close
description: Close one validated issue with an explicit normalized reason and optional atomic comment; verify closed post-state before returning.

name: issue_reopen
title: Issue Reopen
description: Reopen one validated issue with optional atomic comment; verify open post-state before returning.

name: workflow_list
title: Workflow List
description: List bounded GitHub Actions workflows for the validated repository.

name: workflow_get
title: Workflow Get
description: Read one workflow by immutable numeric ID.

name: workflow_run_list
title: Workflow Run List
description: List bounded GitHub Actions runs with reviewed filters.

name: workflow_run_get
title: Workflow Run Get
description: Read one bounded workflow run without duplicating job payloads.

name: workflow_run_jobs
title: Workflow Run Jobs
description: Read bounded jobs and steps for one workflow run.

name: workflow_job_log_preview
title: Workflow Job Log Preview
description: Return a bounded credential-redacted diagnostic preview for one job.

name: dependabot_alert_list
title: Dependabot Alert List
description: List bounded repository Dependabot alerts.

name: dependabot_alert_get
title: Dependabot Alert Get
description: Read one bounded Dependabot alert.

name: code_scanning_alert_list
title: Code Scanning Alert List
description: List bounded repository code-scanning alerts.

name: code_scanning_alert_get
title: Code Scanning Alert Get
description: Read one bounded code-scanning alert.

name: secret_scanning_alert_list
title: Secret Scanning Alert List
description: List bounded secret-scanning alerts without literal secret values.

name: secret_scanning_alert_get
title: Secret Scanning Alert Get
description: Read one secret-scanning alert without literal secret values.

name: secret_scanning_alert_locations
title: Secret Scanning Alert Locations
description: List bounded repository locations for one secret-scanning alert.

name: workflow_dispatch
title: Workflow Dispatch
description: Dispatch one workflow by numeric ID on an explicit ref with bounded string inputs.

name: workflow_run_rerun
title: Workflow Run Rerun
description: Rerun one workflow run by numeric ID.

name: workflow_run_cancel
title: Workflow Run Cancel
description: Cancel one workflow run by numeric ID.
